info.title: Linkly Universal API
info.description: Create, manage, and track branded short links with click analytics, redirects, and QR codes.

post.description: Creates a new link in Linkly.

connectionId.description: The MindCloud connection ID for this app.

url.description: URL. Required to create a new link.

name.description: Optional display name for the link.

slug.description: Optional custom short-code slug. Linkly's current runtime rejects custom slug values in this workspace with `slug must be empty`.

note.description: Optional internal note for the link.

forward_params.description: Whether to forward query parameters to the destination URL.

deleted.description: Whether the link should be marked deleted.

spam.description: Whether the link should be marked as spam.

rules[].description: Optional array of redirect rule objects. Use the nested Rules fields below to define each rule.

rules[].what.description: What the redirect rule matches against.

rules[].url.description: Destination URL to use when the rule matches.

rules[].rule_url.description: Source URL or pattern evaluated by the rule when applicable.

rules[].matches.description: Match expression for the redirect rule.

domain.description: Domain used by the short link.

expiryDestination.description: Destination used after expiry when configured.

gtmId.description: Google Tag Manager ID when configured.

skipSocialCrawlerTracking.description: Whether social crawler tracking is skipped.

spam.description: Whether the link is marked as spam.

workspaceId.description: Workspace ID that owns the link.

401.description: The MindCloud API key is missing or invalid.
